title: 天井 Thian-tsínn
mood: calling your own name in an empty house
subject: rain falling into the courtyard of a grandmother's old house
caption: Taiwanese Hokkien music built on nanguan chamber material. Pipa held horizontally in the nanguan manner with slow, deliberate plucks, dongxiao end-blown flute carrying long sustained lines, the paiban wooden clapper marking the slow meter, and a very quiet ambient synth bed underneath as the only modern element. Slow, refined and spacious, chamber-quiet, with long silences and natural decay. Female voice in slow sustained nanguan phrasing, controlled and unornamented by enka-style weeping. 62 BPM, D pentatonic. Calling your own name in an empty house. No drums, no beiguan percussion, no suona, no pop chorus, no key change.
lyrics:
[Verse]
老厝的天井 落雨 水對瓦簷滴落來
四邊的房間 攏無人 門攏關咧
阮細漢 佇遮看雨 看一下晡
阿嬤佇灶跤煮飯 聲一直傳過來

[Chorus]
天井
落雨的時 規間厝攏咧聽
聽雨 聽灶跤 聽阿嬤叫阮的名
這馬 干焦聽著雨

[Verse]
今仔日 阮轉來 拍開門 一陣塗粉
天井 生草矣 雨猶原對仝一个所在滴
阮徛佇中央 雨滴佇阮的肩胛頭
阮無走 阮予伊滴

[Chorus]
天井
落雨的時 規間厝攏咧聽
聽雨 聽灶跤 聽阿嬤叫阮的名
這馬 阮家己叫一聲

[Outro]
雨停
阮共門關起來
